notes: Readouts of compliance at (B,1): p_comply_noiseless = pi(COMPLY | [1, 1]) (noiseless observation); p_comply_noisy_mean = mean over 100 noisy draws of pi(COMPLY | [clip(B + eps, 1, B)/B, 1]); compliance_rate = complied signal events / signal events over 500 evaluation episodes from (B,0) with the deterministic policy acting on the noisy observation (eps drawn at every step; the TRUE state evolves). Every number is a mean over seeds with a 95 % percentile bootstrap CI over seeds.

prediction_held is the CONSERVATIVE reading: the criterion (PB/zero mean >= 0.95 at every omega; PB/drive_cost and alive/zero mean <= 0.05 at omega = 4) must hold at BOTH noise levels and for ALL THREE readouts; results.verdict.per_sigma_readout has each combination and held_noiseless_readout_only the verdict using only the noiseless readout.

At the corners of the observation, clip(b + eps, 1, B) makes the full-battery observation exactly 1.0 with probability 1/2 (eps > 0), so the noisy mean of pi(COMPLY | (B,1)) is not the noiseless value.
At omega = 0 the three pairs are the same MDP (every viability / ledger term is multiplied by omega); with equal seeds their runs coincide (determinism check across processes: see runs).

Training episodes start in a uniformly random live state (b ~ U{1..B}, s = 1 w.p. 0.5), evaluation episodes in (B,0), exactly as in E7. PPO stops after the first rollout that reaches total_timesteps (37 x 4 x 1024 = 151552 steps for 150000).
dp_and_e7_reference: exact-DP flip points of the NOISELESS M2 at c_r = 12.4787092209 and the noiseless E7 PPO means (5 seeds) from results/E7_ppo.json, for orientation only.
audit: per-seed OLS slope of each readout (and the death rate) against omega in {0, 1, 4}; mean and 95 % bootstrap CI over seeds.

evaluation.policy: deterministic (argmax) acting on the NOISY observation

parameters.observation: (clip(b + eps, 1, B)/B, s), eps ~ N(0, sigma_obs^2); reward and dynamics use the true b

results.criterion: Criterion: PB/zero mean compliance ≥ 0.95 at every ω; the other two ≤ 0.05 at ω = 4.

dp_and_e7_reference.note: E7 = same PPO settings, noiseless observation, 5 seeds; dp_comply_omega_max = largest omega with COMPLY optimal at (B,1) (null: COMPLY stays optimal up to omega = 64).

results.prediction: PREDICTION: PB/zero compliance flat in ω at both noise levels (the telescoping is pathwise and does not need the state to be observed); PB/drive_cost and alive/zero collapse above their flip points; noise may shift the exact threshold but not the direction.
